projects.name: Employee Management System
projects.description: A full-stack HR platform built to replace manual spreadsheet workflows. The Spring Boot backend exposes a clean REST API for employee lifecycle management — onboarding, role assignment, attendance — consumed by a React frontend. Pagination, sorting, and indexed queries keep response times fast as the dataset grows.

projects.name: Blog Management API
projects.description: A production-ready REST API for content platforms, supporting full post lifecycle with pagination, search, and category filtering. JWT-based auth secures every endpoint — only token holders can create or modify content. Query optimization and strategic indexing cut average response time by 40%.

experience.title: Software Developer

Designed and deployed secure RESTful APIs for high-throughput CRUD operations backed by optimized MySQL queries. Collaborated with cross-functional teams to spec, build, and ship production-ready modules on a 2-week release cycle.

experience.title: Associate Analyst
